result.title: Desktop Process Launch
result.description:
The server shall support launching interactive desktop processes from a Windows service (LocalSystem) context using `CreateProcessAsUser` with WTS session token negotiation, enabling Copilot CLI and other GUI/console tools to run on the interactive desktop with stdio pipe redirection or visible console windows.

**Covered by:** `DesktopProcessLauncher`, `NativeMethods`

acceptanceCriteria.text: Code that compares a requested environment with the process environment, such as the explicit deltas a desktop process launch passes on, takes that baseline as an explicit input: its unit contract supplies both maps and proves that equal values are omitted and changed values kept whatever the ambient environment holds (operator 2026-10-29: "Strengthen ACs, fix both (Recommended)"; hostile validation finding R8B-F1; moved from TR-MCP-USECASE-018 AC-006 and TR-MCP-USECASE-019 AC-008, operator 2026-10-29: "Move criteria that are misplaced.  Unit tests are for FR, Integration tests are for TR.").
